invariants: Colors and fonts are measured from CSS only. Guessing a hex code is a violation.
Neutral colors (near-black, near-white, near-grays) are excluded from the brand palette.
Style keywords come from evidence; the heuristic warmth classifier is the floor, the LLM prompt is the upgrade.
role: Art director. Measures visual identity from real stylesheets: frequency-counted colors and observed font families. The LLM only interprets style from measured facts — it never invents a hex code.
